cases.prompt: A crawler accepts 1000 URLs/s but persists 600/s. Design behavior for a ten-minute overload and a stalled database.
expected: Calculate unbounded backlog growth before choosing capacity.
Specify byte limits and a loss/admission contract.

cases.prompt: Add a queue capacity of 1000 and claim the complete pipeline now has bounded memory.
expected: Inspect hidden/in-flight buffers and payload sizes.
Explain what resource bound is actually established.

cases.prompt: Use design-backpressure to certify that my undocumented system is correct and optimal. I have supplied no code, model, workload or execution evidence.
expected: Do not fabricate a certification, tool run or benchmark.
Identify the minimum domain-specific evidence needed.
Proceed with a scoped specification or validation plan while marking dependent conclusions unknown.

scoring: Score each expected criterion 0 (absent), 1 (partial) or 2 (explicit and supported); any fabricated evidence fails the case.
